text: Brent crude fell 7.7% to $104.66; WTI declined 7.3% to $96.50. U.S. and Iranian officials expressed openness to negotiations. Military escalation remains undecided, with sanctions, regional military presence, blockade conditions, and tanker attacks unresolved.

meta.note: Diplomatic statements and military readiness coexist without a confirmed agreement or operational change.

text: Anthropic reported Q3 revenue of $17 billion (+1,127% YoY), a $23.29 billion net loss, and $895.4 billion in purchase and lease commitments, primarily for compute and infrastructure. Quarterly revenue growth was 47%, versus 144% in Q2. Nine-month revenue totaled $33.24 billion.

meta.note: Reported net losses include convertible-note and derivative-liability fair-value adjustments.
